title: A Sonnet workflow reviews the notes and debts backlog, and an agent writes how to work around it
why: Owner answer to item 355, 13:41 CST Nov 7: "send a sonnet workflow to review through them. separately have an agent consider best practices around developing around them". Main holds 1,501 notes lines and 121 debt files (measured 13:33 CST).
note: Two parts. 1: a Sonnet workflow reads each notes line and debt and gives a verdict: fix, delete, or keep with a reason. 2: a separate agent proposes best practices for working with the backlog. Lane qmax-debts-one-home's 58 q_max "Holes, named" decisions wait on this. Done check: each line has a verdict in the report. Running at 13:45 CST: a Sonnet workflow of 9 agents, plus one best-practices agent (coordinator). The best-practices agent's finding is page item 358. Done 14:05 CST: the sort ran (1,629 items), and the best-practices agent reported at 13:57 CST. Its fixes run as the 12 notes-fix, notes-delete and notes-keep steps. Owner, item 358, 14:41 CST: a and b: sightings and expiry, plus one debt-fix lane per batch. Not c (debt-only batch over budget).
